title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-02-13
source: 2-source matrix mix of shnid #97639(SBD) and shnid #123814(AUD)

ai_review.summary: Pristine matrix mix captures a legendary late‑show with soaring Dark Star/Other One/Lovelight sequence; recording is excellent and the performance is hailed as life‑changing.
ai_review.review: The show is consistently described as a pivotal, high‑energy experience highlighted by an extended Dark Star → Other One → Lovelight stretch that many reviewers say ‘hit like a freight train.’  The matrix (soundboard‑plus‑audience) source is praised for its crystal‑clear balance, with only minor brightness issues that some listeners tweak.  Overall the performance and tape are regarded as essential listening for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are overwhelmingly positive, emphasizing both a stellar musical performance and excellent recording quality; the weighted average yields a near‑top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced sound with bright top end that some users add bass/reverb to smooth; far superior to straight audience copies and praised as a pristine document.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, improvisational sequences flow seamlessly—especially the Dark Star → Other One → Lovelight suite—with a reverent audience that enhances the experience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for being ‘in his prime’ with powerful tone during Dark Star.
